createOrReplace.title: Admissions Criteria | Zayed University
createOrReplace.excerpt: Undergraduate Admission Requirements - 2026 - 2027. UAE Ministry of Education Curriculum: No minimum high school overall average required. Subject requirements apply. American Curriculum: No minimum high school overall average required. Subject requirements apply. British Curriculum: Minimum 2 A-Levels with a grade C or higher (excluding Arabic and Islamic Studies). International Baccalaureate (IB Diploma): Minimum 24 points. College of Business - Bachelor of Science in Finance: Minimum 80% in English (Grade 12) or TOEFL iBT 72; Minimum 80% in Mathematics (Grade 12) or SAT Math 530. College of Technological Innovation - Bachelor of Science in Information Technology: Minimum 80% in English (Grade 12) or TOEFL iBT 72; Minimum 80% in Mathematics (Grade 12) or SAT Math 530. Admission to Zayed University is competitive.

createOrReplace.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee | Zayed University
createOrReplace.excerpt: The tuition fees apply to self-funding national students (non-current students) and non-national (international) students. Tuition Fee: AED 2,500 per credit hour. Application Fee: AED 250 + VAT. UAE national undergraduate students enrolled under the government scholarship scheme are entitled to full tuition funding for a maximum duration of five academic years.

set.academic_threshold: UAE Ministry curriculum: no minimum overall average. Plus at least 80% in Grade 12 English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Grade 12 Maths (or SAT Math 530). Competitive: meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.

American curriculum: no minimum overall average. Plus at least 80% in Grade 12 English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Grade 12 Maths (or SAT Math 530). Competitive: meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.

British curriculum: at least 2 A-Levels at grade C or higher (Arabic and Islamic Studies not counted). Plus at least 80% in Grade 12 English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Grade 12 Maths (or SAT Math 530). Competitive: meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.
IB Diploma with at least 24 points. Plus at least 80% in Grade 12 English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Grade 12 Maths (or SAT Math 530). Competitive: meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.

Other curricula: the admissions page lists only UAE, American, British, IB and BTEC; ask Zayed University about yours. Plus at least 80% in Grade 12 English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Grade 12 Maths (or SAT Math 530). Competitive: meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.
